stem: Why does condom use typically decrease among Year $12$ females compared to younger students?

options.text: A transition to the oral contraceptive pill in established relationships
Increased difficulty in accessing condoms as they get older
A lack of knowledge regarding how to use barrier techniques
A total lack of concern regarding any form of protection

explanation: Older adolescents in longer-lasting romantic relationships often switch from barrier methods to hormonal contraception.
rationale: Think about how relationship status influences the choice between barrier methods and hormonal methods.

optionExplanations.A: Older adolescents in longer-lasting romantic relationships often switch from barrier methods to hormonal contraception.
optionExplanations.B: The shift is attributed to relationship dynamics and contraceptive preference rather than a lack of physical access.
optionExplanations.C: The decrease is related to the nature of their relationships and choice of alternative protection, not a loss of technical knowledge.
optionExplanations.D: Most older adolescents still prioritize pregnancy prevention but choose different methods to achieve it.

source.hint: Think about how relationship status influences the choice between barrier methods and hormonal methods.
